description: Location de vélos Vélo'Baie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saint-Brieuc Armor Agglomération. Location and availability of self-service electric bikes in Saint-Brieuc Armor Agglomération. The data are available in GBFS format and make it possible to know: - List of stations (geolocation, name, identifier) - The number of bikes available - The number of places available This data in the General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) format is transmitted ... Coverage: Saint-Brieuc Armor Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle rental Vélo'Baie" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Saint-Brieuc Armor Agglomération. Its keywords include velo-libre-service, velo, velos. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GBFS. The listing shows 2022-10-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
